<!-- Velo stays small on purpose (see "Goal" and its non-goals in SPEC.md).
     An idea becomes work only when the discussion here ends with a decision,
     and a maintainer then adds it to Next in SPEC.md. -->

## Problem

<!-- What you are trying to do and what gets in the way today. Describe the problem, not only the solution. -->

## Who has it

<!-- You, your team, your coding agents? How often? What do you do now instead? -->

## Proposal

<!-- How Velo could solve it: what changes in the web UI, API, CLI or MCP. -->

## Cost

<!-- Rough size, and whether it needs a schema change, a new dependency, or a change to an Invariant in SPEC.md. -->

## Out of scope and alternatives

<!-- What this idea deliberately does not cover, and other ways you considered (including "do nothing"). -->
